text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One morning, I notice Oguri Cap scuffling about with a dejected look on her face.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Argh… Why? Why did I do that?!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: …This morning, I dreamed I had an unlimited supply of carrots.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Just as I was relishing the sheer joy, swimming through that mountain of orange…

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I woke up. I wasn't ready to say goodbye. And yet…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Even during training, Oguri Cap fails to shake out of her slump.
